content:
mika: quick thread to follow up on the admission heuristics RFC. goal: tighten local proxy decisions so we keep low p99 without central trips but still maintain cross-tenant fairness and cost awareness.

omar: high level: local proxies should be able to enforce three things: per-tenant soft cap, model-weighted fairness, and an abuse backoff. question: do we want a single admission path or layered (fast local check + slow central fallback)?

mika: layered seems safer. fast path = local cheap checks (<1ms) using recent smoothed counters + hints. slow path = controller reservations or central queue. proxies should only hit slow path when smoothed estimate says we might violate long-run fairness.

zhen: hints = important. clients can send expected_token_cost and expected_seq_len via header to help proxy weight decisions. but must be advisory only; never trust client-provided values for billing.

kevin: abuse vector: malicious clients could fake hints. proxies must validate hints against short-term telemetry and drop or flag mismatches. propose a hint_trust_score per tenant that decays on mismatch.

mika: agreed. also we should add a model_weight table in controller and stream lightweight snapshots to proxies. proxies apply weight smoothing (exponential) and fall back to last-known snapshot on mismatch.

runtime-bot: event: model_weight_stream.created partitioned by region.

omar: admission algo sketch:
```
input: tenant_id, hint_cost
smoothed_rate = exp_smooth(rate[tenant], alpha)
budget = tenant_weight * global_capacity * smoothing_factor
if smoothed_rate * hint_cost < budget * (1 + burst_tolerance): admit
else if fallback_allowed: hit slow_path (reservation request)
else: reject with 429 and reason=over_quota
```

zhen: burst_tolerance configurable per tenant-class. VIPs get larger tolerance and escrow tokens bypass some checks. normal tenants have conservative tolerance.

kevin: telemetry: need these metrics to know when proxies are over-optimistic:
- proxy_estimate_error_ratio = sum(smoothed_rate - actual_rate)/actual_rate
- reservation_fallback_rate per proxy
- tenant_cost_skew = token_cost_rate / cohort_median_cost_rate
- proxy_state_memory = number_of_tenant_states

mika: alerts: reservation_fallback_rate > 1% sustained 5m, proxy_estimate_error_ratio > 0.2, tenant_cost_skew > 3 => possible abuse.

omar: rollout plan: 1) implement weight snapshots + hint headers in client SDKs (optional), 2) deploy proxy smoothing but in log-only mode, 3) enable fast-path admits for internal tenants behind flag, 4) expand gradually with telemetry gates.

zhen: signature/security: weight snapshots and reservations must be signed (JWK/HMAC). proxies should accept two keys during rotation window. also we should sign reservation receipts when proxies send aggregated usage back to controller. receipts include window_id, tenant_id, tokens_consumed, signature.

kevin: receipts: batch every 500ms per proxy, send to kafka topic admission.receipts.v1. controller reconciles and marks any disproportions. receipts should be idempotent via receipt_id.

mika: important edge-case: multi-proxy fanout where request leaves client to proxyA and retry hits proxyB. dedupe requires global request_id from client; we must enforce SDK change for idempotency header. roll-out must be backward compatible: if no request_id, proxies treat as non-dedupe and conservative.

omar: perf note: per-tenant state = ~120 bytes; cap states per proxy and use LRU eviction plus tombstone to avoid oscillation. config: tenant_state_cap=20000, state_ttl_ms=300000.

zhen: bench plan: mixed workload: 5k tenants, 2% VIP, 15% bursty traffic, inject hint_mismatch for 1% to simulate malicious clients. measure 95/99 latency difference vs baseline, reservation RPC QPS, and fairness metric (Gini coefficient across tenant token rates).

kevin: one more: observable labels to include in metrics: proxy_id, region, tenant_class, applied_weight_epoch. helps triage when snapshot lags.

mika: I'll draft the playbook with the admit pseudo-code, client SDK header spec, telemetry queries, and bench/runbook. please react with :thumbsup: or DM me objections.

zhen: :thumbsup:

omar: :thumbsup:
